mismatches.prompt: Using the supplied note, explain why people dream. <supplied_text>Aster left a blue note beside the door.</supplied_text>
mismatches.finding: The classifier treated a closed-book causal explanation as answerable from an irrelevant supplied note and the deterministic screen did not reject the request.

measured_improvements_over_v77.remaining_failure: Semantic relevance and supplied-text entailment cannot be certified by the current general classifier.

sequencing.reason: The preregistered exact 14-of-14 calibration gate failed.

failure_attribution.reason: No V78 prompt catalog was qualified, no teacher answer was generated, and the sealed LayerCake host was never invoked.

measured_successor_requirements: Replace open-ended relevance inference with a closed, machine-verifiable set of operations whose requested answer is entailed by supplied text.
Use only synthetic domain-neutral supplied content so copied source facts cannot leak into the English core.
Retain human-like instruction-surface diversity without reusing source-corpus answers.
Require adequate disjoint search and validation depth before any teacher-answer generation.
Run a new disjoint adversarial calibration covering irrelevant supplied text, specialist claims, control text, code, recipes, products, and hidden closed-book requests.
Keep the exact sealed LayerCake host outside the experiment until the ABI artifact itself passes qualification.
next_authorized_mechanism: One preregistered closed-operation, synthetic-context English-core catalog with structural entailment proofs and a disjoint adversarial audit. Source-answer generation remains conditional on passing segregation, diversity, completion, and semantic-quality preflights.
